This connection to the sun resonates with Christian teachings, as Jesus is often referred to as the 'Sun of Righteousness' or the 'Light of the World'. Moreover, the name Elenora evokes the image of the Virgin Mary as the 'New Eve', the one who brought light into the world through the birth of Jesus. In this sense, a child named Elenora can be seen as a living testament to the transformative power of God's light and love, a reminder of the divine spark within each one of us.
